notes: An evening of driving, and everything it turned up. You can now pick WHICH moments go in a highlights video before you make it - tick boxes under Process my highlights, built from the moments in the recordings you ticked. Tick crashes for a crashes video, come back and tick overtakes for a second video from the same race; the choice goes in the file name so they never overwrite each other. A recording left running from practice into the race is now cut into one video per session, because nothing used to record WHICH session a moment happened in. Names read date, time, track, car, session, then what the video is - always last, always one of MY HIGHLIGHTS, MY HIGHLIGHTS + TV ANGLES or RACE HIGHLIGHTS + TV ANGLES; the race reel had no car in its name at all. Nothing in the pit lane counts as a highlight any more. The relative overlay is real columns instead of numbers scattered across each row, and keeps its length wherever you are in the field: leading puts you top, last puts you bottom. SMART can actually remember what you ask it to - it had no way to write anything down, so it said 'noted' and noted nothing. The pit box scales its type with the window and cannot be dragged smaller than its own text needs. Also: the corner tree no longer dies on a corner with no time lost, the Save-as prompt opens in front of the overlay, the replay sign stops painting two messages over each other, and the highlights progress bar says which of its two phases it is in.
